quest.title: Last Ride of the Bugbuster Squad
quest.description: The work of catching Abyssal Aphids is making steady progress, and today is the final mission...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Scarlet Phlogiston Honey Pearl x1

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hey, you're here. This is the last place where the Abyssal Aphid was spotted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we're done if we catch it here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Pretty much. Even if a few manage to get away, it's not a big deal. I'll find time to deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I already heard from the tribe that the patients have taken a turn for the better over the last few days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's great news!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Though, there is one fly in the ointment: Your conspiracy theory turned out to be just that, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Seems like those fruit just grow naturally where the Aphids tend to congregate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon never expected some kinda Fatui... or Treasure Hoarder... or some other kind of mastermind behind the scenes... Paimon was just showing the kind of sensible caution any guide worth her salt would have!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure you'll always be vigilant, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's a given!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Alright, let's hurry up and wrap this up then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay! Bugbuster Squad, move out! Time for our final battle!

talks.objective: Go to the final area where Abyssal Aphids were spotted

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #Xilonen? {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two as well? Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Ororon? What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you recovered?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern. Granny spent a few days pouring bitter stuff down my throat and forcing me to rest, and I'm much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Ororon! Are you here to help Xilonen catch Aphids?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Aphids? Oh! So you were the ones who kidnapped Hundred Percent Sweetness...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: No wonder Extreme Sweetness and Unusually Sweet also disappeared... It was you all along.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Uh... Are those all the names of Aphids?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Yep.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It makes it easier to tell them apart. I don't actually judge them, after all, they're still amazing even if they don't produce honeydew.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... These Aphids... were all raised by you?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Actually, I don't really do much that would interfere with their natural behaviors. We just happen to live in the same territory. It's a kind of relationship where we just get along with each other.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Uh... Sorry, I had no idea. But they were contaminated by the Abyss, which was affecting the tribe, so we had to take care of that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right! ...And we didn't harm them, either, just so you know!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Really? That's good. Still, no need to worry, it's not a big deal. In fact, I myself came here to deal with that problem.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: But I must set the record straight. The Aphids weren't contaminated by the Abyss. They're smart little creatures who chose to eat the Abyssal energy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Say what now? They chose to eat it?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Exactly. They only eat a little bit at a time. Though that little bit is enough to make their bodies expand, but it won't kill them.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: After a while, they'll fly somewhere far away, and then create Phlogiston Honey Pearls that bind up the contaminants inside.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: The outer shell of the Pearl acts as a barrier against the contamination, and this way, they can slowly strip away the Abyssal energy from their home.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Though the process must be repeated over and over and over, but they're all patient critters. Even if the ants move, it isn't a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... So they're protecting their home...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: First I've heard of it as well. So they know the land is being invaded, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Yes, Hundred Percent Sweetness and the rest have been fighting hard! They're all really great, capable Aphids.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guess that's "Natlan, the Nation of War" for you.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Though, Ororon, how did you find this place?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's because I fed them some Numberry seeds. They can't digest them, so it doesn't take long for them to excrete them.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: After the seeds hit the ground, they grow quickly, turning into fruiting bushes. If I follow the bushes, I can find them.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Then I gather the Honey Pearls they produce and take care of them, and then use more Numberries to bring them back.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: But it seems like you guys have already done all that for me, and didn't harm them in the process. Really, I'm very grateful to you all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's what was going on with the Numberries! Paimon was draining all her brain juice trying to figure out if there was some kind of plot behind them...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did I cause you any trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, not at all! Don't worry about it!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Ororon, rest assured that we will return all the Abyss-cleaning Aphids back to you, just as they were.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: That would be just perfect! They're all very important living beings, and must be treated well.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Well, since the problem's already taken care of, I'll see you all later! Feel free to drop by and visit me next time, I'll take you to see some other good friends of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then I'll be looking forward to it. Until next time.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Phew! I never imagined things would turn out quite like this. That Ororon sure is a master of "surprises."

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: And thank you both. Without the two of you around, this would've been one boring trip.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: This is for you. It's an uncontaminated Phlogiston Honey Pearl. Don't worry, it's not valuable.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Just think of it like a memento, something to remember these tiny warriors who fight for Natlan by.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've still got one last place to go, come on!
